verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway is primarily a traffic-governance/proxy layer, not a workflow/automation builder, but it does expose declarative config-as-code and imperative commands via kongctl that could support versioning and reapplying (rollback) of gateway/automation entity configurations (AI Agents, A2A routes, MCP servers). There is no evidence of a review/approval workflow, diffing, or dedicated rollback feature for 'automations' themselves. Missing for 10: explicit versioning/history UI, review/approval workflow, and a documented rollback mechanism for agent automations rather than just config-as-code.
